_source: Rulebook 'How the car planning of ES works', section 12 cost table, unless marked assumption.

bentheim_munster_lengerich.cite: §12: Extra transport Bentheim – Münster – Lengerich, about €5,000

default.cite: §1: one extra transport costs about €5,000 to €6,000 (midpoint)

detour.cite: §12: Detour about €500 to €3,500 extra; detour with the night train typically 2 to 3 hours of delay

second_conductor.cite: §12: Second conductor (from 9 occupied cars) about €1,600 per one-way trip on Paris and Prague, about €3,000 on Milan

electricity_per_car_trip.cite: §12: Electricity about €200 per car per one-way trip

refund.cite: §12: >1 hour 25% of the ticket back; >2 hours at destination 50%

avg_fare_eur.cite: ASSUMPTION: €41m ticket sales / 410,000 passengers from the ES opening briefing slide (2026-11-21) = €100. No ticket prices are in the data.

shunting_move.cite: No euro price for a shunting move is in the rulebook. Counted as moves, not euros.
